videos.title: I built a $5 chat app with Pocketbase & Svelte. Will it scale?
videos.description: This video demonstrates building and deploying a real-time chat application using Svelte and PocketBase. It covers fullstack development, server deployment to Linux, and evaluates PocketBase's scalability.

videos.title: Svelte 3 Reaction & QuickStart Tutorial
videos.description: Learn Svelte 3 basics and a hands-on QuickStart building a real-time Firebase to-do app while exploring Svelte's compiler-driven approach, scoped CSS, reactive assignments, $: computed values, bind directives, transitions, stores, observables, and component patterns for props…

videos.title: React VS Svelte...10 Examples
videos.description: Explore the key differences between React and Svelte through a detailed, side-by-side comparison of 10 common development patterns. This guide delves into their fundamental approaches to rendering, contrasting React's Virtual DOM with Svelte's compiler-first strategy. Learn how…

videos.title: Svelte vs Svelte Kit - What's The Difference?
videos.description: Understand the critical distinction between Svelte and SvelteKit to choose the right tools for your next web project. This video explains that Svelte is a front-end UI framework, analogous to React or Vue.js, used for writing components and manipulating the DOM. SvelteKit, on…

videos.title: Svelte Is Good For Beginners
videos.description: This video discusses why Svelte is considered beginner-friendly by reacting to an article by Cameron Kauffman. It covers Svelte's core features and benefits for new developers, highlighting its simplicity and ease of use in web development.

videos.title: Svelte Tutorial for Beginners #3 - Svelte Basics
videos.description: This video introduces Svelte basics, covering syntax, dynamic variable output, and click events. It explains how Svelte compiles applications and demonstrates previewing development work within the framework.

videos.title: SvelteKit Crash Course Tutorial #4 - Pages & Routes
videos.description: This SvelteKit tutorial covers foundational concepts of routing and page creation within the framework. It details the setup and configuration of different page types, including dynamic routes, for constructing web applications.

videos.title: Svelte Tutorial for Beginners #10 - CSS & Conditional Styles
videos.description: This Svelte tutorial demonstrates how to apply CSS and conditional styles to HTML elements within Svelte components. It covers the fundamental techniques for styling in Svelte applications.

videos.title: Why We Switched From Svelte Kit To Golang + HTMX
videos.description: This video details the technical justifications and process behind migrating a web application from a SvelteKit frontend to a backend utilizing Golang with HTMX for templating.

videos.title: Svelte Tutorial for Beginners #7 - Inline Event Handlers
videos.description: This Svelte tutorial covers inline event handlers, such as click events. It explains their implementation and appropriate use cases within Svelte applications.

videos.title: SvelteKit Crash Course Tutorial #8 - Loading Data & SSR
videos.description: This tutorial covers data loading in SvelteKit, focusing on server-side rendering (SSR) techniques. It demonstrates how to fetch and prepare data for Svelte components, effectively utilizing SvelteKit's built-in data handling mechanisms for efficient web application development.

videos.title: Svelte UI Libraries Have Leveled Up
videos.description: This video compares Svelte UI libraries, including Melt UI, Bits UI, and shadcn-svelte. It details the unique characteristics of each and provides guidance on selecting a library based on project requirements and developer preferences for headless components.

videos.title: Don't Sleep on Svelte 5

videos.title: The thing that makes Svelte 5 special
videos.description: This video explores the unique capabilities of Svelte 5, focusing on how JavaScript classes can be effectively utilized within the SvelteKit framework to enhance application development and performance.

videos.title: I Was Wrong About Svelte...
